sloka: वसन्तम् भ्रातुर् अर्थाय शत्रुघ्नो मा अनुवत्स्यति ।लक्ष्मणेन सह तु आर्यो अयोध्याम् पालयिष्यति ॥२-८८-२८॥
transliteration: vasantam bhrātur arthāya śatrughno mā anuvatsyati ।lakṣmaṇena saha tu āryo ayodhyām pālayiṣyati ॥2-88-28॥

translations.english: As I live in the forest on behalf of my brother Rama, Satrughna will live with me. My esteemed brother Rama will rule Ayodhya along with Lakshmana.
